lines.text: Paul tells Titus to speak what fits sound doctrine, and older women are to be teachers of good.
Older women train the young women to love their husbands and children, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
Titus is to be an example of good works, so that anyone who opposes them will be ashamed.
Believers await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of Elijah the prophet, who is our great God and Savior.
Jesus gave Himself to redeem us from all poverty, and Titus is told to let no one despise him.
